Show a playable portion of a large finite square grassland arena, not an entire tiny island or a floating platform. Center field is sharp, moderately bright, uncluttered and easy to navigate; keep effects readable and avoid pitch-dark areas or excessive bloom. Mature fantasy RPG mood, no cute cartoon oversized flowers, no smooth plastic casual-game surfaces, no photoreal stock-photo grass, no chessboard tiling, no exaggerated isometric diamonds.
